attempt_1.label: INVALID TEST INPUT -- NOT A PRODUCT FAILURE
attempt_1.reason_invalid: Turn 2 supplied a ShipmentCode-shaped synthetic value ("SPUAT00201") assuming ShipmentCode was the first required field. The real RequestShippingAddressChange action (registry id 34983027-3f1d-426f-9ee8-df7d70f9e73e) actually asks for CustCode FIRST (pattern ^[A-Za-z]{2}\d{4,6}$), then ShipmentCode (pattern ^[A-Za-z]{2}\d{10,}$) -- confirmed via services.business_action_registry.get_full(). "SPUAT00201" matches neither pattern, so the system correctly kept re-asking for CustCode, and after repeated unrecognized attempts safely escalated to Human Handoff (no crash, no fabrication, no security issue -- but the intended slot-preservation/interruption/resume/correction scenarios never got a chance to run).
